title: When Fusion Order Matters: Insights on Progressive Multimodal Representation Learning for Cross-modal Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.35125v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal video retrieval combines visual, acoustic, and speech information, yet how their fusion order should depend on the data and the retrieval query remains unclear. We introduce Unified Progressive Representation Learning for Order Analysis, or UniPRO, to investigate this question through configurable fusion schedules with matched model components and training settings. Starting from text-to-video retrieval, we find that the tested one-by-one schedules outperform stacked fusion, while changing the order within one-by-one fusion also changes performance. To guide order selection, we examine two complementary considerations: learning difficulty under unequal modality availability and preservation of information relevant to the query. Complete-modality controls show that missing inputs alone cannot explain order sensitivity. At R@1, text and audio retrieval favor schedules that introduce the modality matching the query last. Controll

translated_title: 当融合顺序至关重要时：面向跨模态检索的渐进式多模态表示学习的洞察
translated_abstract: 多模态视频检索结合了视觉、声学和语音信息，但其融合顺序应如何依赖于数据和检索查询仍不清楚。我们提出了统一渐进表示学习顺序分析框架（UniPRO），通过在匹配的模型组件和训练设置下使用可配置的融合调度来研究这一问题。从文本到视频检索任务出发，我们发现所测试的逐一融合调度优于堆叠式融合，而在逐一融合中改变模态顺序也会改变性能。为指导顺序选择，我们考察了两个互补的考虑因素：模态可用性不均情况下的学习难度，以及与查询相关信息的保留。完整模态的对照实验表明，仅凭输入缺失无法解释顺序敏感性。在R@1指标上，文本和音频检索更倾向于最后引入与查询匹配模态的调度……
tldr: 该论文提出UniPRO框架，在严格控制的实验条件下系统研究了多模态检索中融合顺序的影响，发现逐一融合优于堆叠融合，且“最后引入与查询匹配的模态”的调度策略在R@1指标上表现最佳，为融合顺序选择提供了两个互补的指导原则。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces UniPRO, a framework for systematically analyzing fusion order in progressive multimodal representation learning, showing that one-by-one fusion outperforms stacked fusion and that schedules introducing the query-matching modality last achieve the best R@1 performance, guided by two complementary principles of modality learning difficulty and query-relevant information preservation.
